_rag_mode: 'wording': curated AAC words are given only as the standard wording to use if the model mentions that concept (default). 'suggest': the original behaviour — 'prefer words from this list', which the 2026-10-28 smoke eval suggested pulls in typical-but-absent objects (e.g. cup, bowl in a kitchen photo without them).
_personalization: 'similar_scenes': use only this child's boards for the most similar past scenes, with caregiver edits applied (default). 'full_history': the original behaviour — every word the child ever had, in every prompt.
_max_scene_distance: Chroma L2 distance on normalised embeddings; 1.0 is roughly cosine similarity 0.5. Past scenes further away than this are ignored.
